craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha of attainment — verbs are all attainments. Dreamt-owned (imagined-mine); fire-flame/sun-shine similes kept. Rejected: (a) dreamt→imagined → killed: dream keeps unreality. Read aloud: DREAMT-up … AS-fire's-FLAME-shapes, SUN's-shine.

lines: Dreamt up — world-self Bhairava I — mine indeed those world-shapes —
